mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractType", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "sourceStatus",p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "startDate",p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate", p.BDGT_AMT AS "budget",p.REG_DTTM AS "registeredAt",r.PART_ID AS "partId",b.PART_NM AS "partName", COALESCE(b.HQ_YN='Y',false) AS "hq" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT PART_ID FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART WHERE PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND APLY_BGN_YM <= to_char(#{today,jdbcType=DATE},'YYYYMM') ORDER BY APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true LEFT JOIN TB_BS_PART b ON b.PART_ID=r.PART_ID WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id}
mapper.sql: r.REG_USER_ID AS "registeredBy",COALESCE(u.USER_NM,r.REG_USER_ID) AS "registeredName",r.REG_DTTM AS "registeredAt", r.MOD_USER_ID AS "modifiedBy",COALESCE(m.USER_NM,r.MOD_USER_ID) AS "modifiedName",r.MOD_DTTM AS "modifiedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT r.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",r.STEP_SN AS "stepSn",r.PROJ_STEP_CD AS "stepCode", COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,r.PROJ_STEP_CD) AS "stepName",r.STEP_WGHT_RT AS "weight",r.PLAN_BGN_DT AS "startDate", r.PLAN_END_DT AS "endDate",r.CMPL_DT AS "completedDate", FROM TB_PJ_STEP r LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' AND c.CODE=r.PROJ_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=r.REG_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER m ON m.USER_ID=r.MOD_USER_ID WHERE r.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY r.STEP_SN

SELECT r.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",r.MEMO_SN AS "memoSn",r.WRT_DT AS "writtenDate",r.THIS_WEEK_CN AS "thisWeek", r.NEXT_WEEK_CN AS "nextWeek",r.REQ_CN AS "request",r.ACTL_PRGRS_RT AS "actualProgress", FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO r LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=r.REG_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER m ON m.USER_ID=r.MOD_USER_ID WHERE r.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY r.WRT_DT DESC,r.MEMO_SN DESC

SELECT r.ISSUE_ID AS "issueId",r.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",r.ISSUE_TTL AS "title", r.IMPR_CD AS "importance",COALESCE(i.CODE_NM,r.IMPR_CD) AS "importanceName",r.DDLN_DT AS "dueDate", r.ISSUE_STAT_CD AS "status",COALESCE(s.CODE_NM,r.ISSUE_STAT_CD) AS "statusName",r.ACTN_CN AS "action", FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE r JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=r.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE i ON i.CODE_GRP_ID='IMPR' AND i.CODE=r.IMPR_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE s ON s.CODE_GRP_ID='ISSUE_STAT' AND s.CODE=r.ISSUE_STAT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=r.REG_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER m ON m.USER_ID=r.MOD_USER_ID WHERE r.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.IMPR_CD='HIGH' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,r.DDLN_DT,r.ISSUE_ID
SELECT DISTINCT s.USER_ID AS "userId",u.USER_NM AS "userName" FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=s.USER_ID WHERE s.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND s.SCOPE_TYPE_CD='PROJ' ORDER BY s.USER_ID

SELECT CODE AS "code",CODE_NM AS "name",ADD_VAL1 AS "weight",ADD_VAL2 AS "types",USE_YN AS "useYn",DEL_YN AS "delYn",SORT_ORD AS "sortOrder" FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' ORDER BY SORT_ORD,CODE

SELECT h.HIST_ID::text AS "historyId",h.TRGT_TBL_NM AS "targetTable",h.TRGT_KEY AS "targetKey",h.CHG_TYPE_CD AS "changeType", h.CHG_ITEM_NM AS "itemName",h.BFR_VAL AS "before",h.AFT_VAL AS "after",h.CHG_RSN AS "reason", h.REG_USER_ID AS "registeredBy",COALESCE(u.USER_NM,h.REG_USER_ID) AS "registeredName",h.REG_DTTM AS "registeredAt" FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=h.REG_USER_ID WHERE ((h.TRGT_TBL_NM='TB_PJ_STEP' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_STEP s WHERE s.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND h.TRGT_KEY=s.PROJ_ID||':'||s.STEP_SN::text)) OR (h.TRGT_TBL_NM='TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO m WHERE m.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND h.TRGT_KEY=m.PROJ_ID||':'||m.MEMO_SN::text)) OR (h.TRGT_TBL_NM='TB_PJ_ISSUE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i WHERE i.PROJ_ID=#{id} AND h.TRGT_KEY=i.ISSUE_ID::text))) AND h.CHG_TYPE_CD IN ('NEW','UPD') ORDER BY h.REG_DTTM DESC,h.HIST_ID DESC
SELECT COALESCE(sum(EXPS_AMT),0) FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id} AND EXPS_YM >= #{fromMonth} AND EXPS_YM <= #{toMonth}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_STEP SET PLAN_BGN_DT=#{row.startDate},PLAN_END_DT=#{row.endDate},MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=#{now} WHERE PROJ_ID=#{row.projectId} AND STEP_SN=#{row.stepSn}
UPDATE TB_PJ_STEP SET CMPL_DT=#{row.completedDate},MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=#{now} WHERE PROJ_ID=#{row.projectId} AND STEP_SN=#{row.stepSn}

UPDATE TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO SET THIS_WEEK_CN=#{row.thisWeek,jdbcType=VARCHAR},NEXT_WEEK_CN=#{row.nextWeek,jdbcType=VARCHAR},REQ_CN=#{row.request,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ACTL_PRGRS_RT=#{row.actualProgress,jdbcType=NUMERIC},MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=#{now} WHERE PROJ_ID=#{row.projectId} AND MEMO_SN=#{row.memoSn}
